run_upload_diff: run upload.py to upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to a code review server
run_split_patch: run SplitPatch to split an svn diff output into separate patches per file
run_encode_multipart: run EncodeMultipartFormData to encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data body
run_guess_vcs: run GuessVCS to auto-detect whether the current directory is a git, mercurial, or svn repo
run_get_base_files: run GetBaseFiles on a VersionControlSystem instance to retrieve base file contents for each file in a diff
